item.title: My country is banning Roblox instead of addressing the elephant on the room and we are totally screwed
item.author: hi@urovorozu.xyz (🐍)
item.description:
Welp, this is the first blog post that I made and well… unfortunately this one is out of “I really need to write this before I forgot about it because something important happened” moments. And I’m talking about… the Philippines banning Roblox as a whole than doing something with the plundered flood control projects.

Yeah. Real funny of them, huh?

The flood control projects

To give context on the flood control projects; the Philippines is known to have constant floods and natural disasters due to the geographical location that is surrounded by the region of an ocean where typhoons occur, usually in the second half of the year. Since then, there have been government projects that were tasked to fortify the flood control systems across the country. But despite that… nothing has improved since the last time we heard about it. I rarely tune into news except this caught my attention which was a big attention to the masses initally when it was spread around 2024. There’s a Wikipedia article that details everything about it: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flood_control_projects_scandal_in_the_Philippines

Very bad ones, I say. So I mustered up and skimmed over using Hugo since it uses Markdown (the same language Rentry uses) to generate websites.
